swin-food101.label: Swin Food-101 classifier
swin-food101.note: onnx-community/swin-finetuned-food101-ONNX. Standard ImageNet normalization at 224x224. Outputs 101 class logits.

nutritionverse-direct.label: NutritionVerse-Direct (ViT, 2024)
nutritionverse-direct.note: Paper trains on NV-Real with no channel normalization. If predictions look off, use ImageNet norm [0.485,0.456,0.406]/[0.229,0.224,0.225].
